card.summary: The shortest lease is 24 hours at $14 for the Mac mini M4 with 16GB memory and 256GB SSD, billed in advance in USD excluding tax. No setup fees and no commit...

free_tier.stated: The shortest lease is 24 hours at $14 for the Mac mini M4 with 16GB memory and 256GB SSD, billed in advance in USD excluding tax. No setup fees and no commitment; auto-renew is on by default and can be turned off before the order.
free_tier.notes: The published entry price is $14 per 24 hours or $85 a month for the same machine; the 24-hour floor comes from Apple's macOS licence. A card with 3D Secure and a $1 hold is needed to add a payment method.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a physical machine, not an object; the entry machine has a 256GB SSD and a backup disk is an optional add-on at 15% of the plan price

retention.stated: When a plan ends the instance is permanently deleted and all data on it is destroyed; a daily Mac without auto-renew is deleted as soon as its 24 hours end. Backups, when the option is bought, are retained for seven days from deletion.

egress.terms: Unmetered 1 Gbps networking with no data cap on a 100 Gbps backbone; 2.5 Gbps for +$20/mo and 5 Gbps for +$35/mo are also unmetered on monthly and annual plans only. Dedicated public IPv4 and IPv6 are included.

record.interface_detail: A root-capable shell over SSH on port 22 with password or public-key authentication; a graphical macOS desktop over VNC / Apple Screen Sharing on port 59010. Instances are dedicated physical machines, allocated 1:1, never shared VMs.
record.tooling: an SSH client and a VNC viewer; Xcode, Jenkins, GitLab runners and GitHub Actions run on the machine, and an iPhone can be connected through VirtualHere or TestFlight
record.chaining: A dedicated Mac runs an iOS CI/CD or Xcode job with full root and unmetered bandwidth; because the instance and its data are deleted at the end of a paid period, artifacts that must outlive the lease need another record's storage, and the 24-hour minimum makes a short job cost a full day.

limits.value: 24 hours minimum per lease; $14 for the first 24 hours of a Mac mini M4, auto-renewing every 24 hours by default
fail2ban bans an IP for 1 hour after 5 failed logins within 10 minutes on both SSH and VNC

record.limits_note: One daily Mac at a time per account; add-ons are not available on daily plans. Monthly and annual plans give a 24-hour or 3-day grace period on a failed payment, while a daily plan has none.
record.binding_note: The 24-hour minimum lease is what binds a short job: a single hour of use costs the same $14 as a full day, well before the bandwidth or login limits matter.

identity_cost.detail: Every card added goes through 3D Secure verification with a $1 hold released right away, and the first payment is confirmed by the bank at checkout. The account is created with a login email. Identity documents are asked for only if access is restricted for a suspected breach and KYC is required to restore it.

record.reliability_note: 99.9% monthly network and power availability under the SLA; a daily renewal that is not collected ends the contract with no grace period and the instance and its data are erased once the 24-hour minimum lease allows. A failed payment during a monthly or annual term has a 24-hour or 3-day grace period before deletion.
record.confidence_note: The price, minimum lease, network, card and add-on terms are quoted from the vendor's pricing page read on 2026-11-24.
